The system did not receive a valid response. You can try again.

device_ewneo_receiver_programming_mode.description:

Please click "Next" once the receiver is in programming mode.

device_ewneo_receiver_verify.title: Learning Successful
device_ewneo_receiver_verify.description:
✅ **The receiver was successfully learned!**

Assign a name for the new device:

step._comment_ew_receiver_flow: ===== EW-RECEIVER CONFIGURATION FLOW (Easywave Receiver Configuration - Unidirectional) =====

device_receiver_type.title: Operating Mode
device_receiver_type.description: Which operating mode would you like to use?

device_receiver_description.title: Learn Receiver
device_receiver_description.description:
Please put your receiver into programming mode for **{operating_mode}** now.
Press the programming button on the receiver.

For instructions on how to select the correct programming mode, please consult the receiver's manual.

Please click "Next" once the receiver is in the correct programming mode or the LED is flashing in the correct rhythm.

device_receiver_confirm_learning.title: Confirm Learning
device_receiver_confirm_learning.description: Did the LED on the receiver light up continuously for 4 seconds or was the learning process acknowledged by the receiver? (see manual)

device_receiver_verify.title: Learning Successful
device_receiver_verify.description:
Home Assistant was successfully learned into the receiver!

Make sure the programming mode on the receiver has ended, the LED should no longer be flashing.

Assign a name for the new device:

device_receiver_confirm.title: Easywave Receiver - Confirmation

device_receiver.title: Learn Easywave Receiver
device_receiver.description: Press the learn button on the Easywave receiver. Waiting for telegram...

device_save_success.title: Creation Successful
device_save_success.description: The device **{device_name}** is now available and the entities have been created.
